description: This PHP source file declares an abstract class 'AbstractMatcherListener' within the Goteo application. It provides methods to check for the existence of application and console event listeners associated with a given Matcher object.

classes.name: AbstractMatcherListener
classes.description: An abstract class that extends AbstractListener, providing methods to determine the presence of application and console event listeners for a Matcher object.

methods.name: hasAppListener
methods.description: Checks if an application event listener exists for the given Matcher object.

methods.name: hasConsoleListener
methods.description: Checks if a console event listener exists for the given Matcher object.
